description: Detector probes and matched 400-batch layout responses; virtual 2 ms/step; damping off/on. No force retuning.

sampling.motion: Batch maxima and RMS over all ten actual integrations; gain paired with the force applied to that step.
sampling.startupMotion: Every integration in the first 100 steps; no ten-step net-displacement aliasing.
sampling.lengthRms: Unweighted RMS of sqrt(weighted distance squared + 1) minus selected spring target; not a total force residual.
